17ebdaf36a421128ce7d.en: Materials have properties. A property tells us what a material is like.
17ebdaf36a421128ce7d.id: Bahan (material) punya sifat (property). Sifat memberi tahu kita seperti apa bahan itu.

064cfc6838c08388adf9.en: Hard things do not squash. Soft things squash when you press them.
064cfc6838c08388adf9.id: Benda keras (hard) tidak menjadi gepeng. Benda lunak (soft) menjadi gepeng saat kamu menekannya.

fc7109a2baed3a17b5e2.en: Rough things feel bumpy. Smooth things feel flat and even.
fc7109a2baed3a17b5e2.id: Benda kasar (rough) terasa tidak rata. Benda halus (smooth) terasa datar dan rata.

d6d591bca6481d9154c3.en: Shiny things reflect light. Bendy things change shape when you bend them.
d6d591bca6481d9154c3.id: Benda mengilap (shiny) memantulkan cahaya. Benda lentur (bendy) berubah bentuk saat kamu menekuknya.

6e6e4cbcf034e76cf0e7.en: A rubber band is stretchy. It gets longer when you pull it.
6e6e4cbcf034e76cf0e7.id: Karet gelang (rubber band) bisa melar (stretchy). Karet itu makin panjang saat kamu menariknya.

857f64a7b6011a8ad2d3.en: A sponge is soft. It squashes when we press it.
857f64a7b6011a8ad2d3.id: Spons itu lembut (soft). Spons jadi gepeng saat kita tekan.

329bffdb86eaedc34f70.en: A sponge squashes when you press it.
329bffdb86eaedc34f70.id: Spons (sponge) menjadi gepeng saat kamu menekannya.

3ef0fd36841114c6dbf2.en: A mirror is shiny. It reflects light so well that you can see yourself.
3ef0fd36841114c6dbf2.id: Cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny). Cermin memantulkan cahaya dengan sangat baik, jadi kamu bisa melihat dirimu sendiri.

8ccc825eadf2360d27c3.en: A brick looks dull and rough.
8ccc825eadf2360d27c3.id: Batu bata (brick) tampak kusam dan kasar.

fd361ed7f74ae1c34db0.en: A pillow is soft. It squashes when we press it, so it is comfortable.
fd361ed7f74ae1c34db0.id: Bantal itu lembut (soft). Bantal jadi gepeng saat kita tekan, jadi nyaman dipakai.

ab5a713505baa9e12b58.en: A pillow squashes when you press it, so it is not hard.
ab5a713505baa9e12b58.id: Bantal (pillow) menjadi gepeng saat kamu menekannya, jadi bantal tidak keras (hard).

7467207ee9b3a2f19059.en: A pillow has no sharp edges or points.
7467207ee9b3a2f19059.id: Bantal (pillow) tidak punya tepi atau ujung yang tajam.

c3b33616965d8e519f58.en: A rock, a brick and a metal spoon are hard. A sponge, a sock and a feather are soft.
c3b33616965d8e519f58.id: Batu (rock), batu bata (brick), dan sendok logam (metal spoon) itu keras (hard). Spons (sponge), kaus kaki (sock), dan bulu (feather) itu lembut (soft).

1222e18c08f31d78ca4b.en: Tree bark is rough and bumpy. Glass and balloons feel smooth.
1222e18c08f31d78ca4b.id: Kulit pohon (tree bark) itu kasar (rough) dan tidak rata. Kaca dan balon terasa halus (smooth).

35016f2c14b510e194d9.en: A mirror is shiny, a rubber band is stretchy, sandpaper is rough and a feather is soft.
35016f2c14b510e194d9.id: Cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny), karet gelang (rubber band) itu mudah melar (stretchy), amplas (sandpaper) itu kasar (rough), dan bulu (feather) itu lembut (soft).

380543746787562bde86.en: Clear glass is see-through, so we can see through a window. Wood and brick are not see-through.
380543746787562bde86.id: Kaca bening (clear glass) itu tembus pandang (see-through), jadi kita bisa melihat lewat jendela. Kayu dan batu bata tidak tembus pandang.

f25ae0df256fa0084eba.en: Wood blocks the light. We cannot see through it.
f25ae0df256fa0084eba.id: Kayu (wood) menghalangi cahaya. Kita tidak bisa melihat menembus kayu.

4a7cff4ed741195909f6.en: Bricks block the light. We cannot see through them.
4a7cff4ed741195909f6.id: Batu bata (bricks) menghalangi cahaya. Kita tidak bisa melihat menembus batu bata.

40626878dcf9cdd09e93.en: A rubber band is stretchy. It gets longer when we pull it and goes back when we let go.
40626878dcf9cdd09e93.id: Karet gelang (rubber band) itu mudah melar (stretchy). Karet gelang jadi lebih panjang saat kita tarik dan kembali lagi saat kita lepas.

ad86c48cd50aea0f988b.en: A new coin, a mirror and a metal spoon are shiny. They reflect light. Wood and fabric look dull.
ad86c48cd50aea0f988b.id: Koin baru, cermin (mirror), dan sendok logam itu mengilap (shiny). Benda-benda itu memantulkan cahaya. Kayu dan kain terlihat kusam (dull).

ec791d541b98a1e63174.en: A pipe cleaner is bendy. We can bend it into many shapes. A brick and a wooden ruler are stiff.
ec791d541b98a1e63174.id: Kawat bulu (pipe cleaner) itu mudah ditekuk (bendy). Kita bisa menekuknya menjadi banyak bentuk. Batu bata dan penggaris kayu itu kaku (stiff).

1bde050f2c08ca82a867.en: A brick is hard and stiff.

c743e9a37b93e1eecfcf.en: A wooden ruler is stiff. It snaps if you bend it too far.
c743e9a37b93e1eecfcf.id: Penggaris kayu itu kaku. Penggaris itu patah kalau kamu menekuknya terlalu jauh.

9b6ad978a397878dbe19.en: A marble is hard and smooth. A sponge is soft, and a pine cone is rough.
9b6ad978a397878dbe19.id: Kelereng (marble) itu keras dan halus. Spons (sponge) itu lembut, dan buah pinus (pine cone) itu kasar.

05b03254876aa63dad59.en: A sponge is soft and full of holes.

370c101a4d16ea16f0b1.en: A pine cone is hard, but it is rough and bumpy.
370c101a4d16ea16f0b1.id: Buah pinus (pine cone) keras, tetapi kasar dan tidak rata.

d36947a78922c3a4f2a8.en: A sock, a sheet of paper and a pipe cleaner are bendy. A brick, a stone and a wooden block are stiff.
d36947a78922c3a4f2a8.id: Kaus kaki (sock), selembar kertas (paper), dan kawat bulu (pipe cleaner) itu mudah ditekuk (bendy). Batu bata (brick), batu (stone), dan balok kayu (wooden block) itu kaku (stiff).

e40a30e07077a29cb90c.en: A metal spoon is shiny, and we cannot see through it. Clear glass is shiny and see-through. A wooden block is not shiny.
e40a30e07077a29cb90c.id: Sendok logam (metal spoon) itu mengilap (shiny) dan tidak tembus pandang. Kaca bening itu mengilap dan tembus pandang (see-through). Balok kayu tidak mengilap.

afe7d412276bbc9f80b0.en: Clear glass is shiny, but you can see through it.
afe7d412276bbc9f80b0.id: Kaca bening mengilap, tetapi kamu bisa melihat menembusnya.

dcf6c0642d87d1c405b7.en: A wooden block is not shiny.

c6f66eccdd8a16cb3983.en: The question mark box is for things that are not shiny and not bendy. A brick is dull and stiff, so it goes there.
c6f66eccdd8a16cb3983.id: Kotak bertanda tanya untuk benda yang tidak mengilap dan tidak mudah ditekuk. Batu bata (brick) itu kusam dan kaku, jadi batu bata masuk ke kotak itu.

317ae3c013af161d4f29.en: A metal spoon is shiny, so it goes in the top row.
317ae3c013af161d4f29.id: Sendok logam (metal spoon) mengilap, jadi masuk ke baris atas.

8c7506ff70e06e2b6890.en: Paper is bendy, so it goes in the first column.
8c7506ff70e06e2b6890.id: Kertas (paper) mudah ditekuk, jadi masuk ke kolom pertama.

15e86921811a4cbbe191.en: Glass feels smooth. Bricks and bark feel rough.
15e86921811a4cbbe191.id: Kaca (glass) terasa halus (smooth). Batu bata dan kulit pohon terasa kasar.

2d1ac00f33361c5ccd74.en: A stone is hard. You cannot squash it.
2d1ac00f33361c5ccd74.id: Batu (stone) itu keras (hard). Kamu tidak bisa membuatnya gepeng.

ee4d9dcadf74c3a6b1a2.en: A mirror is shiny. We can see ourselves in it.
ee4d9dcadf74c3a6b1a2.id: Cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny). Kita bisa melihat diri sendiri di cermin.

4483bc6282651241b882.en: A sponge soaks up water. It has many tiny holes.
4483bc6282651241b882.id: Spons (sponge) menyerap air. Spons punya banyak lubang kecil.

c878282cdd75f87612ed.id: Air tetap berada di permukaan plastik.

db8456ce4f2f981b9a5a.en: Water does not go into glass.
db8456ce4f2f981b9a5a.id: Air tidak masuk ke dalam kaca.

d51e5137decff5cb6860.en: A plastic sheet is waterproof. Water does not go through it.
d51e5137decff5cb6860.id: Lembaran plastik (plastic sheet) itu tahan air (waterproof). Air tidak bisa menembusnya.

9a20c21c6c2e3363f7b3.en: A plastic duck floats on water. A coin and a spoon sink.
9a20c21c6c2e3363f7b3.id: Bebek plastik (plastic duck) mengapung di air. Koin dan sendok tenggelam.

cf265b8fa866a3c73030.en: A stone is heavy for its size, so it sinks. A feather and a leaf float.
cf265b8fa866a3c73030.id: Batu (stone) itu berat untuk ukurannya, jadi batu tenggelam. Bulu dan daun mengapung.

96395735ff3e2669f3cd.en: A cork, a wooden block and a plastic duck float. A stone, a coin and a key sink.
96395735ff3e2669f3cd.id: Gabus (cork), balok kayu (wooden block), dan bebek plastik (plastic duck) mengapung (float). Batu (stone), koin (coin), dan kunci (key) tenggelam (sink).

51508ecea3834ee182c8.en: Glass, an egg and ice feel smooth. Sandpaper, bark and brick feel rough.
51508ecea3834ee182c8.id: Kaca (glass), telur (egg), dan es (ice) terasa halus (smooth). Amplas (sandpaper), kulit pohon (bark), dan batu bata (brick) terasa kasar (rough).

9481e8f3497a488f391c.en: Boots, bags and raincoats keep water out. Sponges, towels and tissues soak water up.
9481e8f3497a488f391c.id: Sepatu bot (boots), tas (bags), dan jas hujan (raincoats) menahan air supaya tidak masuk. Spons (sponges), handuk (towels), dan tisu (tissues) menyerap air.

cff903534752059152f0.en: A rubber band, a pipe cleaner and wool can bend. A brick and a stone are hard.
cff903534752059152f0.id: Karet gelang (rubber band), kawat bulu (pipe cleaner), dan wol (wool) bisa ditekuk. Batu bata (brick) dan batu (stone) itu keras.

d085eba26400d905757e.en: We can see through glass, clear plastic and water. We cannot see through wood or brick.
d085eba26400d905757e.id: Kaca (glass), plastik bening (clear plastic), dan air (water) itu tembus pandang. Kayu (wood) dan batu bata (brick) tidak tembus pandang.

9f0485bd51dd92b4e358.en: A sponge soaks up water and a raincoat keeps you dry. A mirror is shiny and a pillow is soft.
9f0485bd51dd92b4e358.id: Spons (sponge) menyerap air dan jas hujan (raincoat) membuatmu tetap kering. Cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny) dan bantal (pillow) itu lembut (soft).

6b5a00db94b84f461679.en: A rock is hard and a pillow is soft.
6b5a00db94b84f461679.id: Batu (rock) itu keras (hard) dan bantal (pillow) itu lembut (soft).

1227fe054c0ab01f3056.en: A sponge is soft and a stone is hard. Glass is see-through and a mirror is shiny.
1227fe054c0ab01f3056.id: Spons (sponge) itu lembut (soft) dan batu (stone) itu keras (hard). Kaca (glass) itu tembus pandang (see-through) dan cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny).

225e037be97c6312a439.en: Water runs off plastic, so it is best for an umbrella. The paper gets wet and soft.
225e037be97c6312a439.id: Air mengalir turun dari plastik, jadi plastik paling cocok untuk payung. Kertas menjadi basah dan lembek.

c73194f1278a59140515.en: A mirror is shiny. A wooden spoon, a brick and fabric are dull.
c73194f1278a59140515.id: Cermin (mirror) itu mengilap (shiny). Sendok kayu, batu bata, dan kain itu kusam (dull).

db15747e1c302dc53772.en: Glass is clear, so we can see through it.
db15747e1c302dc53772.id: Kaca (glass) itu bening, jadi kita bisa melihat ke baliknya.

ad63b5576a864a1f8aec.en: Cotton wool is the softest. An eraser is a little soft, a wooden block is hard and a stone is the hardest.
ad63b5576a864a1f8aec.id: Kapas (cotton wool) paling lembut. Penghapus (eraser) agak lembut, balok kayu (wooden block) keras, dan batu (stone) paling keras.

33145e66d8ba7c5acb2a.en: A mirror is smooth and shiny.

2d1ff31791d51783cf0a.en: A pillow or a teddy is soft. A stone or a brick is hard.
2d1ff31791d51783cf0a.id: Bantal atau boneka beruang itu lembut (soft). Batu atau batu bata itu keras (hard).

11afb911e686f3059777.en: A paper towel soaks up water like a sponge, a towel and a tissue.
11afb911e686f3059777.id: Tisu dapur (paper towel) menyerap air, sama seperti spons, handuk, dan tisu.

55d9d13932e581c669d3.id: Benda ini menahan air supaya tidak masuk.

fd51cd38bbc9a7019090.en: It does not soak up water.

6970d66b93e44e2b11f8.en: Rubber is bendy and springs back, so it bounces well.
6970d66b93e44e2b11f8.id: Karet (rubber) mudah ditekuk dan kembali ke bentuk semula, jadi karet memantul dengan baik.

f6fc7c49950398e93e49.en: Plastic is waterproof. Paper soaks up water and goes soggy.
f6fc7c49950398e93e49.id: Plastik itu tahan air (waterproof). Kertas menyerap air dan menjadi lembek.

92eaf9341e9860a0ce11.id: Plastik menahan air supaya tidak masuk.

917471a5de0cb06b914d.en: Pillows are soft, so they are comfortable to sleep on.
917471a5de0cb06b914d.id: Bantal itu lembut (soft), jadi nyaman untuk tidur.

cca4bdb2b703abd72009.en: A brick is hard. You cannot squash it with your hand.
cca4bdb2b703abd72009.id: Batu bata (brick) itu keras (hard). Kamu tidak bisa membuatnya gepeng dengan tanganmu.

51c4fdb0c2394fc94ca5.en: Glass is transparent, so you can see through it.
51c4fdb0c2394fc94ca5.id: Kaca (glass) itu tembus pandang (see-through), jadi kamu bisa melihat ke baliknya.

e922dd0161e65f0681b9.en: A sponge is absorbent, so it soaks up water.
e922dd0161e65f0681b9.id: Spons (sponge) mudah menyerap, jadi spons bisa menyerap air.

b526eb14de39065222f5.en: The sponge and cotton wool squashed, so 2. The wooden block is hard. Easy to squash is soft.
b526eb14de39065222f5.id: Spons dan kapas menjadi gepeng, jadi ada 2. Balok kayu itu keras. Yang mudah menjadi gepeng itu lembut (soft).
